summary: Defines an experimental ICMP message type for IPv4 used with the Identifier-Locator Network Protocol (ILNP). It dynamically updates identifier and locator bindings for an existing ILNP session. It comes from the IRTF Routing Research Group.

eli5.summary: When a computer moves to a new place on the network, this message tells its friend the new address so the chat keeps going. It is only an experiment.

questions: how does ilnp update locators on ipv4
